title: The story so far.
intro: From early basketball and television to product leadership, startups and locally deployed AI.

items.title: Sharing ideas on stage
items.text: Alongside building products, I speak with people shaping business and technology.

items.title: Building the DoneIsBetter portfolio
items.org: Moldován Csaba Kft — narimato · hatori · amanoba · messmass · sso · spot · reply
items.text: Shipping a compounding stack of interconnected platforms — AI assistants, sports analytics, SSO infrastructure, learning tools and content platforms — all open on GitHub and growing.

items.title: Jury & Pre-seed Partner · GITEX Africa, Marrakesh
items.text: Judged 400+ African startups on the Fintech & Blockchain track — and closed three pre-seed investments on the floor, backing founders from the African continent.

items.title: Host · Taipei Smart City Summit & Expo 2023
items.text: Hosted the Taipei Pavilion at the Smart City Summit & Expo 2023 in Taiwan — on-floor interviews and sessions on smart-city innovation and global partnerships.

items.title: Keynote · Hungary–Taiwan Bilateral Reception
items.text: Keynote address at the Hungary–Taiwan bilateral reception in Budapest, representing digital entrepreneurship and cross-border innovation.

items.title: Keynote · GITEX Global, Dubai
items.text: "Creating a bolder digital future together" — keynote at GITEX Global 2022, one of the world's largest technology conferences.

items.title: Locally deployed AI and business applications
items.text: Developing AI models and business software with a focus on privacy, security and technological independence.

items.title: Corporate Strategy Specialist
items.text: Business management and startup development across the fan-engagement platform, shaping product direction and strategic partnerships.

items.title: International Speaker · Fórum Internacional de Empreendedorismo no Esporte
items.text: International keynote on entrepreneurship and innovation in the sports industry.

items.title: Co-Founder (Charity)
items.text: Co-founded a response to COVID-era school closures. More than 100 product owners, developers and Scrum Masters helped over 700 educational institutions move to digital learning.

items.title: HRBEST 2019 — Gold (Arany)
items.org: Product of the Year in HR · Profession (Abimato)
items.text: Hungary's highest HR innovation recognition — awarded for Abimato, the recruitment platform built under the Profession.hu brand.

items.title: Venture Partner
items.text: Digital strategy, market research and hands-on support for founders — empowering startups for success inside Hungary's leading early-stage fund.

items.title: Head of Future Lab · Profession.hu
items.text: Built and led Europe’s largest HR research lab and an MVP Factory, delivering prototypes for job portals and HR companies in 10+ countries. Abimato won HRBEST Gold in 2019.

items.title: Opening Keynote · Blockchain Conference, Zaporizhzhia
items.text: "The pure math behind the cash" — opening keynote before a packed audience at the Blockchain Conference in Ukraine.

items.title: IDC Chief Data Officer Forum 2018
items.text: "2020, the year of personal data" — presenting on data strategy and privacy at the IDC CDO Forum.

items.title: Panel · Central European University, Budapest
items.text: Panel discussion at CEU on technology, digital strategy and the future of work.

items.title: Speaker · IBC 2017, Amsterdam
items.text: Presented at IBC — one of the world's leading media and entertainment technology conferences.

items.title: CXO & Founder · Moldován Csaba Kft
items.text: Established the product studio and venture vehicle — "Make your product done."

items.title: Product Director · Riaktr
items.text: Led product teams turning complex telecom data and client needs into scalable products and MVPs.

items.title: VP of Product · ImpressTV
items.text: Led product and acquisition knowledge transfer for personalised recommendations, targeted advertising and audience analytics. In 2014, the service delivered over 200 million recommendations a day.

items.title: Head of Products · Leonar3Do
items.text: Led product development for Leopoly, moved products toward SaaS, and supported international expansion across EMEA, Turkey, India and Russia.

items.title: Launched Indulj.Be and Mobile Weekend
items.text: Started a crowdfunding platform and organised a Central European mobile application development competition.

items.title: A broader focus on early-stage businesses
items.text: After a stroke, began supporting startups and making seed investments while continuing media work with Telemedia through 2013.

items.title: Co-founder · International Media Centre
items.text: Launched seven thematic television channels and built Central Europe’s first HD studio centre, with five studios.

items.title: Co-founder · MEXAW
items.text: Launched the 24/7 MusicBox Asia channel in China and built three television studios and four thematic channels in Lebanon.

items.title: Product Director · Telemedia InteracTV
items.text: Joined as employee seven and helped grow the company to 700 people. Its interactive shows reached 70+ channels, with 20+ studios worldwide.

items.title: Head of Design & Lab · MTVA
items.text: Started as a graphic operator and later led Creative and R&D. Work included the 1998 live sports broadcasts on the internet, Hungary’s first live virtual studio, and ‘Fragments from Nagano,’ an early Hungarian blog.

items.title: Played basketball at Kelenföld Vandals Streetball Collective
items.text: Played basketball as part of the Streetball Collective.

items.title: Basketball · Nagytétény SE & Kelenföld Vandals
items.text: Played basketball for Nagytétény SE and was part of the Kelenföld Vandals Streetball Collective.
